title: Symptom intensity profiles and inter-symptom correlations across subtypes of burning mouth syndrome
html: This study aimed to compare average and maximum symptom intensities and inter-symptom correlation structures across subtypes of burning mouth syndrome (BMS) to clarify their clinical and mechanistic differences. Baseline questionnaire data from our previous prospective cohort were retrospectively analysed. Ninety-eight postmenopausal women with BMS were classified into primary (n = 50), secondary (n = 21), or combined (overlapping primary and secondary features; n = 27) subtypes according to clinical and laboratory criteria.
